faq.q: What is the origin of Nazmul?
faq.a: Nazmul is associated with Arabic. Nazmul is the Bengali form of Arabic نَظْمُ الْحَقّ (Naẓm al-Ḥaqq), meaning 'order of the truth'.
Yes — the underlying form نَظْمُ الْحَقّ is Arabic.
Nazmul can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Nazmul should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Naẓm al-Ḥaqq is a compound of Arabic elements, not itself a Quranic personal name.
